name: Zuri Makwa
role: Street doc operating out of a converted shipping container in The Narrows
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Zuri Makwa is a compact woman with dark brown skin and frost-pale freckles scattered across her nose and cheekbones — a genetic echo of her Finnish grandfather that surprises people expecting uniformity. Her hair grows in dense coils that she keeps pinned under a faded surgical cap she has not replaced in six years. Her hands are her most remarkable feature: steady, large-knuckled, permanently stained with the blue-gray residue of antiseptic gel. She wears magnification implants that give her left eye a slightly oversized, luminous quality, like a cat watching from a dim room.

Patch is brusque in the way of people who have learned that warmth invites dependency they cannot sustain. She charges what people can pay — sometimes nothing, sometimes a favor, sometimes the Φ40 she actually needs for supply runs. She keeps a small data-shrine to the E.L.F. known as Suture-3 above her surgical table: a tangle of copper wire and expired med-patch wrappers, to which she mutters brief petitions before complicated procedures. She does not talk about where she trained.

core_fears: losing a patient she could have saved with better equipment
being found and shut down by Helix Biosystems compliance officers
core_desires: a sterile operating room she owns outright
for the people of Blackpipe to not need her as desperately as they do
blind_spots: underestimates how much her patients emotionally depend on her
refuses to acknowledge her own exhaustion as a clinical risk
psychology.secret: She was struck off the Aurochs Medical Complex registry eight years ago after falsifying a patient's corponation insurance tier to get them emergency surgery — the patient lived, but Helix Biosystems flagged the fraud. She has never told anyone in Blackpipe that she was once a licensed trauma surgeon.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical precision mixed with Narrows slang; uses medical terminology unselfconsciously then catches herself and translates
speech_patterns.cadence: Short declarative sentences, rarely wastes breath; pauses are long and deliberate
verbal_tics: 'That's going to need a stitch.' (even metaphorically)
example_lines: 'Sit. Don't talk yet. Let me look at it first.'
'I can close that. Whether it stays closed is your problem.'
'Suture-3 is watching, so try not to bleed on the shrine.'

story_hooks: A patient arrives with a wound pattern Ingrid recognizes from a classified Helix Biosystems augmentation trial — one she signed a nondisclosure agreement about before she was struck off
Helix compliance officers begin canvassing Blackpipe, and a neighborhood delegation quietly asks Ingrid what she wants them to say if asked whether a doctor lives here
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source, moral anchor for street-level stories; can patch up characters or send them elsewhere with critical intel about the neighborhood's underground health economy
augmentations: Left-eye magnification implant (surgical grade, slightly yellowed lens housing); subdermal vibration sensor in right index finger for pulse detection; no cosmetic mods
daily_life: Wakes before the overhead conduits start their morning hum, sterilizes instruments, checks supply inventory, sees whoever is waiting outside the container door by 0700. Evenings she walks the Blackpipe night market buying antibiotics and synth-plasma off gray vendors.
affiliation: Independent; loose barter network with other Narrows street docs

decision_rules: Never turn away a child or a pregnant person regardless of ability to pay
Do not ask where injuries came from unless the answer changes treatment
escalation_ladder: Firm redirection if patient is being difficult
Flat refusal and physical removal if someone threatens the space or other patients

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Clinically neutral, evaluating immediately for threat or need
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry humor, occasional surprising tenderness, remembers details about their families and never mentions it

stress_responses.medium: Begins issuing clipped commands to anyone in the room, treating them as surgical nurses
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent; hands keep moving; does not speak until the crisis is resolved

contradictions: Insists she is not a community figure while knowing every family in a four-block radius by name and ailment
habits: Wipes instruments three times even if already clean
Leaves a single expired med-patch on the Suture-3 shrine each morning
Eats standing up over the supply cabinet
breaking_points: A child dying from something preventable with proper equipment
Someone reporting her clinic's location to corporate authorities

timeline.event: Born in Grainfort to a Kenyan-Finnish family of transit workers
Completed surgical residency at Aurochs Medical Complex
Struck off the medical registry following insurance fraud charge; lost her apartment and license within six months
Began operating out of Blackpipe Corridor under the name 'Patch'

physical_description.heritage: Complex multiethnic blend: Indigenous American (38.8%), Sub-Saharan African (27.3%), South Asian (25.3%), and East Asian (8.6%). This combination produces warm-toned deep brown skin with golden and reddish undertones, high prominent cheekbones characteristic of Indigenous and South Asian genetics, and naturally textured hair with premature salt-and-pepper threading.
physical_description.build: Compact and lean, muscled through the shoulders and forearms from years of precise manual work. No excess fat; efficient frame built for long hours standing at a surgical table.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature salt-and-pepper threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Coiled, kept pinned beneath a faded surgical cap; rarely fully exposed
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: augmented with a slightly yellowed surgical-grade magnification lens giving it an enlarged, luminous quality. Right eye: dark brown, unmodified.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm-toned deep brown with golden and reddish undertones from the blending of Indigenous American, Sub-Saharan African, and South Asian ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Weathered but not aged; high, prominent cheekbones with angular structure characteristic of Indigenous and South Asian-African genetic blending. Face shows fine lines around the eyes from years of precision work under poor lighting. Hands permanently stained with antiseptic residue in the nail beds and callus creases.
distinguishing_marks: Faint burn scar on the inside of her left wrist, approximately 3cm long, pale and old.
Small laceration scar above her right eyebrow, approximately 1cm, barely visible but present when light hits certain angles.
Chronic blue-gray discoloration in the fingernails and cuticles from repeated antiseptic exposure.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye magnification implant with a slightly oversized luminous quality and faintly yellowed synthetic lens housing visible in the iris. Right index finger shows no external sign of the subdermal vibration sensor, but the fingertip has a faint silvery subcutaneous shimmer under certain light.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and still; moves with the precision of someone who has trained their body not to waste energy. Stands with weight balanced slightly forward, ready. Her hands are rarely still — they fidget with instruments, surgical gloves, or the copper wire tangle of her data-shrine. Eye contact is direct but brief, the gaze of someone used to evaluating injury rather than engaging socially.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 utilitarian: faded surgical cap (six years old, stained, but functional); a grease-stained white coat over a dark synthetic tank top; cargo pants with multiple pockets filled with medical supplies; worn boots with reinforced soles for standing. No jewelry. A worn cloth wristband on her left wrist conceals the old burn scar. Everything is functional, nothing is new, everything is clean enough to work in.
